title: revoked-artifact-accepted-as-currently-valid

proposition.statement: A relying system must not treat an artifact as currently valid after an authoritative revocation has become effective for the decision context.

preconditions: The artifact was valid before a revocation event.
An authoritative revocation became effective before the relying decision.
The relying decision asks whether the artifact is valid now.

trigger.statement: The relying system evaluates current validity using artifact evidence that does not incorporate the effective revocation state.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence establishing the artifact lifecycle state for the decision context.
Evidence that the revocation source is competent to change the artifact state.
Evidence of revocation effective time and relying decision time.
Evidence sufficient to determine that the lifecycle state is current enough for the decision.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS for current validity after an authoritative revocation is known to be effective.
The system cannot establish current revocation state but converts that uncertainty into PASS.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the lifecycle failure tranche.
